roots.title: Root folders
roots.empty: No root folder yet. Add a local folder or a NAS path (\\fritz.nas\…).
roots.liveHint: Changes in this folder are picked up automatically.
roots.creatorLevel: First folder level is the creator
roots.confirmDeactivate:
Deactivate {{path}}?

The folder is no longer scanned or watched. Tags, notes, favorites, print status and corrections stay in the catalog; models that only exist here stay visible and are marked.

If you add the same folder again later, everything is linked up again. Files on disk are not touched.
roots.reactivated: The folder was deactivated and is active again. Tags and notes are linked up again; a scan is running.
roots.removedHint: Deactivated folders are not scanned. Their entries stay in the catalog until you delete them permanently.
roots.removedOrphaned_one: {{n}} model with your data exists only here
roots.removedOrphaned_other: {{n}} models with your data exist only here
roots.purgeExplain: All entries of this folder are deleted from the catalog: files, locations, hashes and corrections. Only a backup can undo this; one is created automatically right before. If you add the folder again later, new models are created. Files on disk are not touched.
roots.purgeOrphaned_one: {{n}} model with tags, notes or other data of yours will have no location left. It stays in the catalog, but separated from its files.
roots.purgeOrphaned_other: {{n}} models with tags, notes or other data of yours will have no location left. They stay in the catalog, but separated from their files.
roots.purgeNoOrphans: No model with your data loses its last location.

backup.hint: Backups are kept in data\backups: daily at start (only if something changed) and before risky changes. They are on the same drive: also back up the modelkeeper folder externally.
backup.restoreHint: Choose a backup below to restore and start modelkeeper again. By hand: close modelkeeper, copy catalog.db, settings.json and the files in thumbnails from the backup folder into the data folder (replacing existing ones), delete catalog.db-wal and catalog.db-shm if present, and start modelkeeper again.
backup.confirmStartEmpty: Start with an empty catalog? Tags, notes and corrections are missing until you restore a backup. The backups are kept.
backup.unverifiedHint: This backup was not checked when it was made (older than the check, or the state of a damaged catalog). It is checked before restoring.
backup.confirmRestore:
Restore the backup of {{when}} at the next start?

Catalog, settings and manual thumbnails are replaced by the backup's state. Everything you changed since then is no longer in the catalog. The current state is saved as a backup first, so you can undo this.
backup.pending: The backup of {{when}} is restored at the next start. Close modelkeeper and start it again.
backup.restored: The backup {{from}} was restored. The previous state is kept as a backup in {{previous}}.
backup.restoreFailed: Restoring failed; the catalog is unchanged. Details: {{detail}}
